# TODO_LIST - Sample Project Setup

This is a sample TODO_LIST file for testing the /execute @path/to/file.md shortcut.

## Tasks

1. Initialize project structure with necessary directories
2. Install dependencies from requirements.txt [Tool: install_packages]
3. Set up database connection and run migrations
4. Configure environment variables in .env file
5. Run initial tests [Make: make test]
6. Build the project [Make: make build]
7. Start development server [Tool: start_server]
8. Verify the application is running on localhost:8000

## Notes
- Make sure all dependencies are installed before running tests
- Database should be running before executing migrations
